definition.Hessian_map: closed-range intertwiner preserving the D0 block and gauge/Dirac quotients
definition.coefficient_map: finite pushforward from kappa0,kappa1,Zchi,Zsigma,A0,G0,g to S5/S4 coefficients
definition.domain_map: intertwiner of variational, adjoint and boundary domains
definition.field_maps: pullback/pushforward maps for metrics, spinors, gauge connections, scalars and projectors
definition.measure_map: normalized fiber/collar integration with orientations and units

why_minimal: All levelwise coefficients can be finitely typed and every term varied; only the common cross-level functor remains unlicensed.
why_not_inequivalence_theorem: The repository proves absence of a sourced map, not mathematical impossibility of every future map.
why_not_scale_only: Gauge, spinor, projector, measure and domain pushforwards are missing even in dimensionless form.
